review_metadata.change_summary: Added empty string validation for --loop3-agents, --loop2-agents, and --product-owner parameters

feedback.issue: Empty parameter validation logic is implemented but not explicitly covered in existing test suites
feedback.suggestion: Add dedicated test cases for empty parameter validation. Example: Test that --loop3-agents '' is rejected with proper error message. Recommend adding to test-cfn-orchestration.sh or creating focused parameter validation test suite.

feedback.issue: SKILL.md documentation does not document the three-layer parameter validation pattern used in argument parsing
feedback.suggestion: Add section documenting parameter validation requirements (existence check → empty string check → functional validation). Include examples showing error messages for each validation layer. This will help future maintainers understand the defensive programming pattern.

feedback.issue: The --mode parameter does not validate for empty string, while --loop3-agents, --loop2-agents, and --product-owner now do
feedback.suggestion: For consistency, consider adding empty string validation to --mode parameter. Though the whitelist check provides some protection, explicit empty validation would match the pattern used elsewhere. Low priority as whitelist check catches the issue.

feedback.issue: Implementation uses three-layer validation pattern but pattern is not documented in code comments
feedback.suggestion: Add inline comment explaining the three-layer validation pattern: Layer 1 (existence), Layer 2 (non-empty), Layer 3 (functional). Example: '# Layer 2: Ensure parameter is not empty (prevents downstream failures with unclear error messages)'

strengths: Clear, specific error messages for debugging
Proper bash constructs with correct variable quoting
Early validation prevents resource exhaustion attacks
Proper validation prevents denial of service via empty agent lists
Consistent with shell script injection prevention practices
Early rejection prevents downstream processing of invalid data

untested_gaps: Empty --loop3-agents parameter (not in existing test suite)
Empty --loop2-agents parameter (not in existing test suite)
Empty --product-owner parameter (not in existing test suite)

maintainability.assessment: Implementation is clear and maintainable. Error messages are explicit. Pattern is easy to extend to other parameters. Minor gaps in inline documentation and test coverage.

regression_analysis.notes: Changes only add new rejection cases for values that would have failed downstream anyway. Early rejection actually improves user experience by providing clearer error messages. No impact on successful executions with valid parameters.

summary.recommendation: APPROVED - Implementation is production-ready. Implementation successfully prevents silent failures and provides clear error messages for empty parameters. Recommend adding explicit test coverage and documentation updates in follow-up work.
